metadata.name: TPI Content Rubric v3 — E-E-A-T + HCU + GEO Edition
metadata.author: Jimmy T7
google_updates_addressed: E-E-A-T Experience (Dec 2022 onward) — first-hand field experience signals
Helpful Content System / HCU (March 2024 core merge) — objection handling, completeness
AI Overviews / GEO (2024 mainstream) — structured table/list formats for AI citation
Knowledge Graph / Local SEO — NAP consistency for entity profile
changes_from_v2_1: REMOVE S6 (Supplement ratio 1đ) — low diagnostic value; convert to preflight advisory
REMOVE R6 (Head-tail heading connection 1đ) — LLM scoring inconsistency, overlap with R5
S1: 7→5đ (overlap with S2/S5)
S2: 5→4đ (overlap with S1/S5)
P1: 5→4đ (A1 already covers compact opening signal)
P3: 2→1đ (P4 covers positive version of specificity signal)
R2: 5→4đ (G3+G2 cover complementary prominence signals)
R3: 3→2đ (SI1 covers intent match more precisely)
R4: 6→5đ (G2 incentivizes machine-readable EAV format)
SI1: 4→3đ (HC1 now covers depth of helpfulness)
I1: 7→6đ (E1+E2 provide complementary originality signals)
I2: 5→4đ (HC1 rewards analytical depth)
ADD E1 (4đ, Rule): First-hand experience signals — E-E-A-T
ADD E2 (2đ, Rule): Staff/author credential attribution — E-E-A-T
ADD E3 (2đ, Rule): Data freshness date stamp — E-E-A-T Trustworthiness
ADD G2 (3đ, Rule): Structured HTML table + ordered list — AI Overviews / Passage Ranking
ADD G3 (2đ, Rule): NAP consistency in CTA — Knowledge Graph / Local SEO
ADD HC1 (3đ, LLM-Haiku): Helpful completeness / objection handling — HCU
